reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) discusses SPS for fine-grained HEAs and general powder metallurgy benefits, but provides no specific support for vapor deposition coating of W particles, improved wettability, void elimination, or enhanced thermal transport in W-Cu composites. The key premises rely on claims not addressed by the cited passages.
premises: Vapor deposition can coat W particles with a Cu-wetting or HEA interlayer
Such a coating improves wettability and interdiffusion with Cu during sintering
Improved bonding eliminates voids and phase separation at W-Cu interfaces
Eliminating voids enhances thermal transport under irradiation
SPS can consolidate coated powders while preserving fine microstructure
